review.gallery: The Select Group Artistry Two cover and living-room render are distinct from the selections for Artistry One. Seven identical design renders appear in both original developer brochures and are labelled as shared. The DLD image shows undeveloped plot 7, project 4261, inspection album 3802.
review.location: The project-location link on both Artistry developer pages resolves to 25.191518, 55.305886 and is labelled as shared. Travel times come from the Artistry Two brochure’s printed legend.
review.floorPlans: Nine complete key-plan pages from the October 2026 brochure, and four apartment drawings published by EZRE and Sky Land. Sky Land shows a specific area beside three images. Those figures are attributed to the broker separately from the developer’s collection ranges. The brochure labels Tier 2 as levels 23–33, while the website alt text labels 22–33. The separate brochure level 22 page is an amenities plan. The selector follows the printed plate.

unavailable: Verified entrance, photographs of the completed building, and individually measured area schedules or standalone sheets for the specific duplex penthouses.
